from gurobipy import *

def solve_problem():
    # Create a new model
    m = Model("Optimization_Problem")

    # 2. Variables
    vars = {}
    lin_expr = 0
    vars['Var_0'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=11.93, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_0')
    lin_expr += 5.42 * vars['Var_0']
    vars['Var_1'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=11.84, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_1')
    lin_expr += 3.3 * vars['Var_1']
    vars['Var_2'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=19.11, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_2')
    lin_expr += 1.28 * vars['Var_2']
    vars['Var_3'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=7.82, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_3')
    lin_expr += 2.19 * vars['Var_3']
    vars['Var_4'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=5.81, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_4')
    lin_expr += 9.22 * vars['Var_4']
    vars['Var_5'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=10.16, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_5')
    lin_expr += 5.82 * vars['Var_5']

    m.setObjective(lin_expr, GRB.MINIMIZE)

    # 3. Constraints
    m.addConstr(9.86 * vars['Var_2'] + 4.48 * vars['Var_3'] + 4.84 * vars['Var_4'] + 4.99 * vars['Var_5'] >= 58.44, name='C0')
    m.addConstr(2.35 * vars['Var_0'] + 4.05 * vars['Var_1'] + 0.8 * vars['Var_2'] + 7.52 * vars['Var_3'] + 1.94 * vars['Var_4'] >= 43.2, name='C1')
    m.addConstr(8.41 * vars['Var_1'] + 3.22 * vars['Var_2'] + 9.12 * vars['Var_4'] + 7.33 * vars['Var_5'] >= 55.03, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(2.36 * vars['Var_0'] + 1.14 * vars['Var_3'] + 7.7 * vars['Var_4'] >= 56.4, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(0.69 * vars['Var_0'] + 1.45 * vars['Var_1'] + 3.46 * vars['Var_4'] + 5.17 * vars['Var_5'] >= 24.07, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(8.75 * vars['Var_2'] + 6.45 * vars['Var_4'] + 0.46 * vars['Var_5'] >= 49.61, name='C5')

    # 4. Optimize
    m.optimize()
    return m

Subject: Cost-minimizing capacity plan to meet the new platform commitments

Team,

As we prepare for the upcoming service window, we need to assemble a mix of capacity options that meets or exceeds our six service-level obligations while keeping total acquisition spend as low as possible. The six obligations cover processing capacity, memory service, storage performance, network headroom, security/compliance, and high availability. Below are the levers available to us, with the unit economics, procurement limits, and how each option contributes to the required service levels.

The levers

1) Memory-Optimized Nodes
- Commercials and availability: Each node costs 5.42. We may purchase none or up to 11.93 nodes, but only in whole units.
- Service-level impacts per node:
  • Processing capacity: no contribution.
  • Memory service: adds 2.35 units.
  • Storage performance: no contribution.
  • Network headroom: adds 2.36 units.
  • Security/compliance: adds 0.69 units.
  • High availability: no contribution.

2) Storage-Optimized Appliances
- Commercials and availability: Each appliance costs 3.3. We may purchase none or up to 11.84 appliances, in whole units only.
- Service-level impacts per appliance:
  • Processing capacity: no contribution.
  • Memory service: adds 4.05 units.
  • Storage performance: adds 8.41 units.
  • Network headroom: no contribution.
  • Security/compliance: adds 1.45 units.
  • High availability: no contribution.

3) On-Demand Compute Blocks
- Commercials and availability: Each block costs 1.28. We may provision any fractional amount up to 19.11 blocks.
- Service-level impacts per block:
  • Processing capacity: adds 9.86 units.
  • Memory service: adds 0.8 units.
  • Storage performance: adds 3.22 units.
  • Network headroom: no contribution.
  • Security/compliance: no contribution.
  • High availability: adds 8.75 units.

4) Rack-Mounted Systems
- Commercials and availability: Each system costs 2.19. We may purchase none or up to 7.82 systems, in whole units only.
- Service-level impacts per system:
  • Processing capacity: adds 4.48 units.
  • Memory service: adds 7.52 units.
  • Storage performance: no contribution.
  • Network headroom: adds 1.14 units.
  • Security/compliance: no contribution.
  • High availability: no contribution.

5) Premium Converged Clusters
- Commercials and availability: Each cluster costs 9.22. We may scope fractional capacity up to 5.81 clusters.
- Service-level impacts per cluster:
  • Processing capacity: adds 4.84 units.
  • Memory service: adds 1.94 units.
  • Storage performance: adds 9.12 units.
  • Network headroom: adds 7.7 units.
  • Security/compliance: adds 3.46 units.
  • High availability: adds 6.45 units.

6) Edge Gateway Capacity
- Commercials and availability: Each package costs 5.82. We may procure any fractional amount up to 10.16 packages.
- Service-level impacts per package:
  • Processing capacity: adds 4.99 units.
  • Memory service: no contribution.
  • Storage performance: adds 7.33 units.
  • Network headroom: no contribution.
  • Security/compliance: adds 5.17 units.
  • High availability: adds 0.46 units.

Market limits and service-level floors

To be considered compliant, our combined plan across the above options must meet the following minimums:
- Processing capacity: at least 58.44 units.
- Memory service: at least 43.2 units.
- Storage performance: at least 55.03 units.
- Network headroom: at least 56.4 units.
- Security/compliance: at least 24.07 units.
- High availability: at least 49.61 units.

All quantities can be set to zero if not needed, subject to the availability caps and whether the item must be purchased in whole units or can be provisioned fractionally, as noted above. Our objective is to find the least-cost combination that satisfies or exceeds every one of these thresholds.
